notes.title: Pro Cycling Manager 2022 - Available June 9!
notes.content:
Hello Managers!

Combining management and real-time racing, Pro Cycling Manager puts you into the shoes of a sports director. Scouting, recruitment, sponsor management, training and race strategies are all tasks the director must do to reach the very top of the sport. This new edition has over 260 races and 680 stages, including the 21 official stages of the 2022 Tour de France. 

[b]Pro Cycling Manager 2022[/b] will be available on [b]June 9[/b], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767560/?snr=2_groups_partnerevents_]add it to your wishlist now[/url]!

[h2]2022 Features[/h2]

Pro Cycling Manager 2022 makes you a sport director. Make all the decisions necessary to take your team to the top: your responsibilities include recruitment, planning objectives and race programmes, sponsor management, scouting future talent, training, race strategy and much more. 
You can also create your own rider in [b]Pro Cyclist[/b] mode. Join a team and prove you can be the leader, then do what it takes to shine in the peloton. Can you rise to become one of the best? 
Pro Cycling Manager 2022 lets you compete against players from around the world in [b]online mode[/b]. 

[list][*]New talent scouting system
[*]A more energetic and attacking peloton
[*]More options for customising your game experience
[*]An easier-to-use interface (new Cyclist page)
[*]Redesigned stamina and resistance system
[*]The 21 official stages of the 2022 Tour de France[/list]

[h3][b]NEW SCOUTING SYSTEM[/b][/h3]
A good sport director must know how to recruit future talent, which is why we have set up a new scouting system. You have to send your scouts to different regions in order to uncover the best talent. Your scouts become more effective and improve over time. They regularly send you information (about potential, characteristics, etc.) which you use to make your choices (observation, integration in the development team, etc.) so you can learn more about the riders. You are, of course, in direct competition with the other teams. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213742/29bda411324226b13fa1ec36a7f89dd4baa78f0f.png[/img]


[h3][b]NEW GENERATION OF RIDERS[/b][/h3]
This new system is based on the level and potential of the young cyclists, using a 6-star grading system. Now the young riders who are created are juniors from 16 to 18 years old, with the pool comprised of 1,500 to 2,000 young cyclists each year (3 times more than before). These new riders will be more versatile and will develop similarly to the current stars. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213742/26f3a2a15459ccca9a1bb6e85f72b08ad2e56c85.png[/img]


[h3][b]RIDER DEVELOPMENT[/b][/h3]
Just like with the young talent, we want to have more versatile riders, so the development system has been redesigned to take this into account. It is also critical for your riders to perfectly integrate the team, establishing a good relationship with the coach, or they will not progress optimally.


[h3][b]MORE VARIED RACE[/b][/h3]
In Pro Cycling Manager 2022, thanks to a more varied peloton, you experience scenarios that are different from the usual blueprint of a Tour stage, for example. You can find yourself in a race that is action-packed from the start, with favourites taking the lead, and a variety of attacks right from the first hour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40213742/acc119f25ad97fe4d5307f6f6f044da84ec803cc.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]OTHER IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3]
The interface has been redesigned, with a total overhaul of the cyclist page that now incorporates new statistics, highlighted rider capabilities and results, and the addition of an interface comparing cyclist characteristics.

Stamina and resistance scores have a bigger effect on how effort is exerted during a race. This allows some riders to attack several times or manage their effort at the end of the race better.

The race-day condition is now closer to the announced provisional condition. To enable comprehensive customisation, you can now adjust 2 parameters: bonus amplitude (from +5 to -5 or complete deactivation) and activation or deactivation of variation.

The simulation time has been optimised and is now twice as fast as before. 

You can now have specific team jerseys for a given race.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.6.2
notes.content:
Greetings Managers!

The 2022 road cycling season has just begun; game mods have been amended, and so it's time to release an update that covers several aspects of [b]Pro Cycling Manager 2021[/b]:

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3][b]1. Leaders' participation in Grand Tours[/b][/h3]
We have improved the allocation of objectives, particularly for the Grand Tours (France, Spain and Italy):
[list]
[*] We fixed a problem where, in certain cases, some team leaders took no Grand Tour objective and thus did not take part in these races.
[*] We have re-balanced the participation in the Grand Tours, where Spain and Italy were weaker than France.
[*] In general, a better balance in the choice of objectives for all riders.[/list][i][u]Developers' comment[/u]: changes impact games that have already started, but since the calculation of objectives is made at the start of a new season, changes will only take effect the following season. For example, if your game is in January, February, July... 2023, changes will [b]only be visible[/b] in the 2024 season.[/i]


[h3][b]2. Improvement to race planning[/b][/h3]
Race planning AI has been tweaked, especially for team leaders.
[list]
[*] Better balance of race days during the season: in general, leaders have fewer race days.
[*] Adjustment to AI behaviour that favoured the selection of the best riders to complete a squad when one or several riders were missing.
[*] Greater chance of the best riders taking part in World Tour stage races, such as Paris-Nice, Dauphiné and other week-long stage races.
[*] Less chance of the best riders taking part in less prestigious races, such as Tour of Turkey, Tour of Guangxi...[/list][i][u]Developers' comment[/u]: changes made to race planning AI have immediate effect[/i]


[h3][b]3. Recovery during stage races[/b][/h3]
Correction of a bug that prevented the mechanism from working properly, with freshness stuck on "Excellent" in stage races.
Improvements to evolution of freshness by taking the Recovery attribute more into account and adding increased granularity, with 7 levels of freshness instead of 5: Excellent, Very Good, Good, Average, Mediocre, Bad, Very Bad.

[i][u]Developers' comment[/u]: changes made to freshness have immediate effect.[/i]


[h3][b]4. Multiplayer pause[/b][/h3]
Addition of a pause to non-ladder multiplayer games: the host can use the "-" (minus) key to slow down the speed of the game to 0 in order to initiate a pause. 

[i]Important note: Caution! The "P" keyboard shortcut is no longer active in this case.[/i]


[h3][b]5. Correction of a display bug in the team interface[/b][/h3]
The display of the number of times a team has taken part in the Liège-Bastogne-Liège race was incorrect on the Team page.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.4.2
notes.content:
Greetings Managers,

We've released a new update for Pro Cycling Manager 2021 (version 1.0.4.2).

Please read the Patch Notes below to learn about its content.

[list]
[*]AI race improvements regarding the problem “too much agressivity by the leaders in the mountain” (they kept attacking from bottom of the climbs, too-often with too high pacing after an attack, some teams defends too much and with higher pace than they should to cover attacks of riders that was not so dangerous).
[*]AI roster improvements : better choices for sprinters and some northern classic riders, especially for races like Paris-Nice and other “1 week” stage races that are not for pure climbers, important riders are less interested by minor continental races. Also important riders from conti pro teams should participate much less to “.2” races.
[*]Optimizations on race simulation times, especially mid/end seasons.
[*]Optimizations on week and month turns.
[*]Fix the visual bug with shirts on Pro Cyclist palmares, where a wrong shirt was highlighted when winning certain races.
[*]Fix a crash on 720p resolutions when you open a cyclist’s pop-up.
[*]Correction of a crash at a week turn that occurred in certain cases where a saved game was altered using external tools. 
[*]Correction of a Pro Cyclist bug where it was possible to train on the same day as a race.
[*]New official team equipments : Team DSM, Astana - Premier Tech, B&B Hotels p/b by KTM, Team TotalEnergies.
[*]Fix a problem with Québec after race podium.
[*]Fix a bug on Hall of Fame page where riders did not appears anymore when they were retired
[*]Correction of a display bug on the Planner page in Career mode: the fitness and tiredness curves were not always refreshed for the preceding week. [/list]

Thank you for your continuous source feedback, our team keeps working on improving the quality of the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Beta Version 1.0.4.0
notes.content:
Hello Managers,

A new update for Pro Cycling Manager 2021 is available on the Beta servers. Before deploying this update on the public servers we would like to have your feedback on the modifications we bring with the 1.0.4.0 update.

Here's the process to follow in order to join this Beta:
[olist][*] In your Steam Library, right-click on Pro Cycling Manager 2021
[*] Click on [b]Properties[/b]
[*] Click on Beta
[*] Select the Beta "open-beta-test"[/olist]

Finally, here's the Patch Notes for the modifications this update will bring to the game.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2][list]
[*] AI improvements with the “too much agressivity by the leaders” (they kept attacking from bottom of the climbs, too-often with too high pacing after an attack, some teams defends too much and with higher pace than they should to cover attacks of riders that was not so dangerous).
[*] AI roster improvements : better choices for sprinters and some northern classic riders, especially for races like Paris-Nice and other “1 week” stage races that are not for pure climbers, important riders are less interested by minor continental races. Also important riders from conti pro teams should participate much less to “.2” races.
[*] Optimizations on race simulation times, especially mid/end seasons.
[*] Optimizations on week and month turns.
[*] Fix the visual bug with shirts on Pro Cyclist palmares, where a wrong shirt was highlighted when winning certain races.
[*] Fix a crash on 720p resolutions when you open a cyclist’s pop-up.
[*] New team equipments : Team DSM, Astana - Premier Tech, B&B Hotels p/b by KTM.
[*] Fix a problem with Québec after race podium.
[*] Fix a bug on Hall of Fame page where riders did not appears anymore when they were retired[/list]


The fixes and changes apply directly without re-starting a new career or season (if you're in a career, for AI roster improvements, most of the things will update on the next month).

As they are no structural modifications, it's possible to rollback to the normal branch (1.0.3.2) and continue your game if for any reason you do not want anymore to be on the "open-beta-test" branch.

Thank you for your continuous support!

Sincerely,

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.3.2
notes.content:
Greetings Managers,

We've released a new update for [b]Pro Cycling Manager 2021[/b] (version 1.0.3.2). In this update, we've fixed the the World & European Championships issue, added new equipments and more!

Please read the Patch Notes below to learn about its content.

[h2]Gameplay/3D Race[/h2]
[list][*] Improvement of individual time-trial (ITT) gameplay: addition of "toxin" effect. When a rider empties his red energy bar, he is limited for a few seconds as he recovers energy. It is displayed as a flashing energy bar. During short time-trials, you must pay close attention to this bar. The yellow energy bar is more of a determining factor on longer time-trials.
[*] Improvements and corrections in team time-trials (TTT): greater team cohesion.[/list]
[h2]Pro Cyclist[/h2]
[list][*] Correction of bug that prevented World and European Championships from taking place in Pro Cyclist mode.[/list]
[h2]Manager[/h2]
[list][*] Correction of a problem in national team races (World and European Championships). Under certain conditions, a simulation could replace a 3D race.
[*] Improvements to selection of objectives by riders.
[*] Improvement to the function that categorises races at the start of a season (impacts on various AI decisions).
[*] Improvements to riders' race schedules: more control over race days, specific attributes of riders as regards hilly or cobblestone classics, better evaluation of races by the riders.
[*] Correction of a bug in the choice of rider objectives: non-European riders could sometimes target the European Championships.
[*] Improvement to the planning of breaks by trainers: no more early season breaks (January, February), better management when several objectives come one after the other.[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list][*] Correction to spelling bugs in the list of trophies in the Pro Cyclist interface
[*] Correction of a display bug in the list of trophies when there was no national TT championship
[*] Correction of a display bug in Pro Cyclist mode: when there is insufficient knowledge of a team-mate, his fitness is no loner displayed in the rider pop-up
[*] Correction of a display bug in a rider pop-up: the rider's season results tab was not correctly displayed when on the port-race results page.
[*] It is no longer possible for a player to add an objective when it overlaps an already planned objective.
[*] Display in the following races of the rider's World and European Championships pop-up.[/list]
[h2]3D[/h2]
[list][*] Update of the texture of the Movistar frame (new colouring)
[*] Addition of Israel Startup Nation equipment (frame, wheels, helmet).
[*] Addition of Trek-Segafredo equipment (frame, wheels, helmet).
[*] Addition of EF-Nippo equipment (frame, wheels, helmet).
[*] Addition of more variants for teams with generic equipment
[*] Adjustment of chainsets on all equipment.
[*] Addition of beige walls to tyres on several wheels for greater visual diversity.[/list]
[h2]Stages[/h2]
[list][*] Correction to the 2020 variant of stage 5 (TT) on the Tour of Andalusia (riders blocked on launch ramp).
[*] Redesign of Canadian classics (Quebec, Montreal) in terms of route décor.
[*] Correction to a bad name for stage 16 of the Tour de France (Pas de la Case - Saint Gaudens).[/list]
[h2]Jerseys/Database[/h2]
[list][*] Update of TotalEnergies team (new name and jersey).
[*] Update of Qhubeka-NextHash team (new name and jersey).
[*] Update of Movistar team (new jersey).
[*] Update of distinctive Tour de France 2021 jerseys.
[*] Replacement of list of first/last names of new riders who are created each year (in collaboration with "Rodgerdavies" of the community).[/list]
[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list][*] Addition of checks for modified databases and mods.[/list]

Thank you for your continuous source feedback, our team keeps working on improving the quality of the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
Greetings Riders,

We've released the first post-launch update for [b]Pro Cycling Manager 2021[/b]. Please read the Patch Notes below to learn about its content.

[h2]3D[/h2]
[list][*] General improvement in rendered image of 3D equipment: more vibrant colours and more realistic materials.[/list]
[h2]3D Race[/h2]
[list][*] Correction of a bug that made feeds longer, especially during hilly and mountain stages.[/list]
[h2]Manager[/h2]
• Improvements to AI squad (these changes do not require a new career to be started):
[list][*] Correction of a problem that could overload the seasons of key riders on the team, especially after the month of June.
[*] More refined criteria for the AI choices of team-mates in race planning.
[*] Better balance/spread of races.
[*] Breaks in preparation are taken into account in the management of race schedules.[/list]• Correction of a rare crash that could occur during a season in Career or Pro Cyclist mode, linked to a problem with illness/injuries.

[h2]User Interface[/h2]
[list][*] Correction of a possible display problem in the "Last race" column of riders on the Team page.
[*] Correction to the display of the team abbreviation on the race info page during national team races (display of a rider's professional team rather than his national team).
[*] Improvement for the addition of rider objectives: display of races by month, and then by prestige (instead of: by race category, and then by alphabetical order).
[/list]

Thank you for your continuous source feedback, our team keeps working on improving the quality of the game!
